decisions.reason: After surviving its first year, this market-data-based margin analysis looks close to aspiration and fits the firm’s platform and analytics trajectory, so continued learning is more attractive than withdrawal.
The gas tariff comparison remains close to established capabilities and customer needs, and in a growing software market the firm likely sees enough expected payoff and slack to retain it.
A regional electricity tariff calculator addresses a core utility use case and, having remained after the broader product-line pruning in 2024, likely sits at or above aspiration for now.
Although narrower as a standalone tool, it complements the surrounding tariff and process solutions and therefore is likely to be kept as part of the expanding central platform.

This product line still carries the highest withdrawal risk because of lighter visibility and possible overlap with adjacent tariff tools, but its continuing strategic fit makes retention slightly more likely than exit.
